CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2577 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 997dadc906c8a98343944639c6464f38dbb0b6da. Bus nonce: 86b8bd99a5c489ec795088bf560c68f2. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 997dadc906c8a98343944639c6464f38dbb0b6da`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 997dadc906c8a98343944639c6464f38dbb0b6da` or `Fix review: blocked 997dadc906c8a98343944639c6464f38dbb0b6da <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 86b8bd99a5c489ec795088bf560c68f2`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `997dadc906c8a98343944639c6464f38dbb0b6da` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2577 997dadc906c8a98343944639c6464f38dbb0b6da") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2577-86b8bd99`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Review of PR #2577 (topic r10-flow-dispatch, branch fix/r10-flow-dispatch, group R10-FLOW-DISPATCH) at head 997dadc906c8a98343944639c6464f38dbb0b6da (verified as the PR head; the handoff ref is at 11c9209a5b0429e18bc00a5f01b367762d4332ed and the head is a merge of it). Re-review after a block.

Verify, mutation proof and null controls for every quantified claim, every body figure re-measured at this head:
(1) Re-run the whole PR with the verdict's survivors as mutants: explicit-roster-ref-ignored, cli-head-dropped, cli-roster-ref-dropped, fetch-skipped (second-clone), plus the previously killed head-ignored, privacy-off and brief-drop. Each must fail a named check; the unmutated tree is the null. Re-measure cloud_dispatch's self-test count; the body's figure must match.
(2) Check the conflict-resolution merge: each conflicting hunk kept both sides' behaviour (main's carry-section prompt checks and the PR's behaviour). Compare the merge against its two parents.
(3) Check every body Carry for a roster owner citing #2577: run carry_audit --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body and also look the items up on the roster (item 92bca45d on R10-ORCH-MACHINERY, item b87aa9e4 and 1fb1501b on R10-FLOW-MAIN-GATE). Confirm the earlier note that the R10-FLOW-MAIN-GATE carry names a control and does not contradict the ruled deferral.
(4) ## Red checks answers every red check-run at this head, read from the check-runs API per commit (not `gh pr checks`); nightly-status and ci-ratchet grade main (main's ci-ratchet red is runner-speed variance owned by R10-CI-LAYOUT).
(5) `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 997dadc906c8a98343944639c6464f38dbb0b6da` is clean.
Orchestrator note: tools/pr/approve_held_runs.sh --dry-run on fix/r10-flow-dispatch found no action_required runs, so no CI run is held.
Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. First line `Fix review: merge 997dadc906c8a98343944639c6464f38dbb0b6da` or `Fix review: blocked 997dadc906c8a98343944639c6464f38dbb0b6da <class>: <reason>`.
